description: This file defines the 'StockStatus' model class within the OpenCart catalog localisation namespace. It interacts with the database to retrieve stock status information, either a single status by ID or a list of statuses, utilizing caching mechanisms.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing stock status data within the OpenCart localisation module.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status entry from the database based on provided stock status ID.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of stock statuses, with optional sorting, pagination, and filtering, utilizing caching for performance.
